news.title: Talcum Powder Glimpse Unveils A Hilarious Chase Featuring Shiva Kandukuri
news.summary: The makers of Talcum Powder have released a hilarious official glimpse into the film, starring Shiva Kandukuri and Drishika Chander. Directed by Sainath Ponna, the project is scheduled to hit theatres on November 13, 2026.
body: The makers of the upcoming Telugu film Talcum Powder have officially unveiled its first glimpse, offering audiences a humorous preview of the project. Headlined by Shiva Kandukuri and female lead Drishika Chander, the film is directed by Sainath Ponna and presented by Raj Kandukuri, known for backing acclaimed titles like Pellichoopulu and Mental Madhilo.

Clocking in as a hilarious introduction, the newly released footage centers around a drug peddler named Bunty, setting up a chaotic narrative involving cops and the drug mafia hot on his trail. The preview also features notable appearances by Venkatesh Maha and A Jeevan Kumar, alongside a special presence by presenter Raj Kandukuri, which has successfully sparked curiosity among movie enthusiasts.

Behind the camera, Osho V handles the musical score, while GV Ajay Kumar and Surya Ponnapalli take charge of cinematography and editing respectively. With anticipation building following this initial promotional asset, Talcum Powder is officially locked for a grand theatrical release on November 13, 2026.
news.dek: The makers of Talcum Powder have released a hilarious official glimpse into the film, starring Shiva Kandukuri and Drishika Chander. Directed by Sainath Ponna, the project is scheduled to hit theatres on November 13, 2026.

news.title: Mahesh Babu Praises Dont Trouble The Trouble After Private Screening
news.summary: Superstar Mahesh Babu has shared high praise for Dont Trouble The Trouble following a private screening ahead of its October 2nd release. He commended lead actor Fahadh Faasil and debutant producer SS Karthikeya for crafting a deeply moving and entertaining experience.
body: Superstar Mahesh Babu has stepped forward to laud the upcoming film Dont Trouble The Trouble, calling it a beautifully complete and well-crafted cinematic experience. After catching a private screening of the movie, the actor took to social media to share his glowing review ahead of its scheduled October 2nd theatrical release.

In his public appreciation, Mahesh Babu highlighted the stellar performance of Malayalam actor Fahadh Faasil, praising his continuous evolution and chemistry with young co-star Ssara. He also extended warm congratulations to debutant producer SS Karthikeya—who partnered with Shobu on the project—alongside director Shashank for successfully bringing the intricate world of the film together.

The project marks an important production debut for SS Karthikeya, son of filmmaker SS Rajamouli. With a strong endorsement from a major industry star and a pre-release event attended by actor NTR, Dont Trouble The Trouble heads into its release weekend carrying significant positive buzz.

news.title: Telugu Version Of Nivin Pauly And Soori's Sanchari Postponed
news.summary: The Telugu release of Sanchari, starring Nivin Pauly and Soori, has been postponed from its original October 1 date. Makers cite a title issue as the reason for the delay, with a revised arrival date to be announced soon.
body: The scheduled simultaneous Telugu release of Sanchari has been officially put on hold. Originally set to arrive in cinemas alongside its original Tamil version, 17 Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai, the Telugu dubbed version missed its initial October 1 theatrical rollout due to unforeseen title issues.

Directed by Ram and starring Nivin Pauly alongside Kollywood actor Soori in a critical capacity, the project marks an immediate release for Pauly following prior successes. The film also features actress Anjali, with musical compositions by Yuvan Shankar Raja and production backed by Suresh Kamatchi under V House Productions.

While the original language version proceeds with its schedule, the team behind the Telugu distribution has confirmed that a new release date for Sanchari will be revealed to the public shortly once the title complications are officially resolved.
news.dek: The Telugu release of Sanchari, starring Nivin Pauly and Soori, has been postponed from its original October 1 date. Makers cite a title issue as the reason for the delay, with a revised arrival date to be announced soon.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Crosses ₹150 Crore Worldwide, Eyes Long Holiday Weekend
news.summary: Nani's starrer The Paradise has completed its first week at the box office, grossing over ₹150 crore worldwide. As collections slow down across Andhra Pradesh, the upcoming holiday weekend offers a crucial window for the film to meet its financial targets.
body: Nani's latest cinematic outing, The Paradise, has wrapped up its first week in theaters with a worldwide gross collection exceeding ₹150 crore. While the movie registered record-breaking numbers initially and emerged as the biggest opening of the actor's career, its momentum has slowed down in several regions following the opening weekend.

Region-wise performance shows mixed results for the production. The Nizam area remains a strong territory, steadily pulling in decent numbers and clearing its break-even threshold with GST factored in. However, several other pockets across Andhra Pradesh are currently facing an uphill battle to recover their distribution investments.

To maintain theatrical momentum, lead actor Nani has been actively touring Andhra Pradesh to meet fans and encourage crowds to experience the project on the big screen. Trade circles and audiences have widely praised his continuous promotional efforts post-release.

The makers are now pinning their hopes on an extended holiday period, driven by Gandhi Jayanti on Friday. Despite fresh competition arriving in theaters in the form of new releases like Simga and Don't Trouble The Trouble, the extra holiday advantage could give The Paradise the momentum it needs to solidify its box-office standing.
news.dek: Nani's starrer The Paradise has completed its first week at the box office, grossing over ₹150 crore worldwide. As collections slow down across Andhra Pradesh, the upcoming holiday weekend offers a crucial window for the film to meet its financial targets.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Slays in Style for Latest Filmfare Cover Amid Upcoming Projects
news.summary: Taapsee Pannu stuns on the latest Filmfare cover in a series of striking outfits. While her recent big-screen outings faced box office hurdles, the actress is gearing up for her upcoming role as ACP Komal Sharma.
body: Taapsee Pannu has once again captured the fashion spotlight, featuring prominently on the newest cover of Filmfare. The actress showcased a versatile wardrobe for the shoot, opening with a sky-blue sequin mini dress paired with a golden potli and standout curls.

The editorial spread featured multiple distinct looks, ranging from a printed teal co-ord set and a shimmering gold gown to a royal blue slit dress and a chic white bandeau set with a bubble hem, with every ensemble drawing praise.
Away from fashion spreads, the year has presented theatrical challenges for the actress, with her recent films Advocate Raavi and Gandhari failing to perform strongly at the box office.

Looking ahead, Pannu is keeping her momentum strong by focusing on her professional slate. She is currently shooting for Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan?, where she portrays ACP Komal Sharma, keeping fans expectant for a robust theatrical comeback.

news.title: Akshay Kumar and Priyadarshan's Crime Thriller Haiwaan Suffers Major Box Office Collapse
news.summary: Directed by Priyadarshan and starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, the crime thriller Haiwaan has ended its theatrical run below ₹10 crore nett. The film faced pre-release criticism for being a remake and suffered from weak word-of-mouth.
body: The crime thriller Haiwaan, directed by Priyadarshan and featuring top stars Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, has finished its theatrical run as a major box-office disappointment. The movie opened to a lukewarm reception with just over ₹2.5 crore nett on its first day.

Following the opening day, the film managed a first weekend collection of ₹6.7 crore nett before collapsing entirely. Its lifetime collections closed at a shocking ₹9 crore nett, marking exceptionally low returns for a project headlined by major actors.

Industry observers noted that the feature faced hurdles prior to its theatrical arrival, drawing criticism from audiences for being an official remake of the Malayalam film Oppam released a decade prior. Combined with weak word-of-mouth, its commercial reach remained severely limited.

The disappointing commercial outcome has reportedly prompted director Priyadarshan to steer away from non-comedy projects with Akshay Kumar moving forward, sending ripples of concern through the trade ecosystem.
news.dek: Directed by Priyadarshan and starring Akshay Kumar and Saif Ali Khan, the crime thriller Haiwaan has ended its theatrical run below ₹10 crore nett. The film faced pre-release criticism for being a remake and suffered from weak word-of-mouth.

news.title: Ravi Teja's Irumudi Claims Global No. 1 Spot on Netflix with Massive Viewership
news.summary: Following a profitable theatrical run, Ravi Teja and Shiva Nirvana's Irumudi has found immense success on digital platforms. The film has crossed 6.8 million views, claiming the global No. 1 spot for non-English movies on Netflix.
body: Irumudi, headlined by Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja and directed by Shiva Nirvana, continues its successful streak after transitioning from theaters to streaming. Produced by Mythri Movie Makers and featuring an ensemble cast including Priya Bhavani Shankar and Baby Nakshatra, the project was previously a profitable venture for its makers and distributors.
Since premiering on Netflix on the 18th of the month, the movie has made a major splash internationally. It has officially captured the global No. 1 position among non-English films on the platform.

The streaming release has registered an impressive viewership of over 6.8 million so far, cementing its status as a rare title that triumphed commercially in cinemas while matching that success on digital channels.
The strong dual performance across both theatrical and OTT mediums underscores the deep resonance the narrative and performances have established with audiences globally.

body: National Award-winning producer Raj Kandukuri is presenting a brand new cinematic venture titled Talcum Powder under his Dharmapatha Creations banner. The film features Shiva Kandukuri in the lead role alongside female lead Drishika Chander, marking a fresh collaboration for the banner known for backed acclaimed entertainers.

The project has officially commenced its promotional rollout by unveiling a first glimpse titled The First Sprinkle. The introductory video centers around a drug peddler named Bunty, who finds himself in deep trouble after unintentionally making a critical misstep. With law enforcement and a group of goons closing in, the narrative quickly spirals into a high-stakes and unpredictable situation.

Helmed by writer and director Sainath Ponna, the movie aims to blend crime, comedy, and drama within a contemporary storytelling framework. The initial footage also offers brief introductions to supporting characters played by Venkatesh Maha and A Jeevan Kumar. The technical crew features GV Ajay Kumar handling cinematography, Osho V composing the music, and Surya Ponnapalli managing the editing.

With its distinctive premise and quirky character dynamics, the promotional glimpse has successfully piqued audience curiosity. Talcum Powder is officially slated to arrive in theaters on November 13.

news.title: Chandoo Mondeti Confirms Multi-Starrer 'Mahakaal' with Rana Daggubati and Akshay Kumar
news.summary: Director Chandoo Mondeti has confirmed that he will helm a Hindi-Telugu bilingual project tentatively titled Mahakaal, uniting Rana Daggubati and Akshay Kumar. In an exclusive update, the filmmaker clarified the project's current pre-production status and debunked rumors regarding Sanjay Leela Bhansali's involvement.
body: Filmmaker Chandoo Mondeti has broken his silence on heavy industry speculation, confirming his next directorial venture will bring together Rana Daggubati and Bollywood star Akshay Kumar. Tentatively titled Mahakaal, the venture is planned as a Hindi-Telugu bilingual set against a mythological backdrop inspired by the history of Ujjain.

Addressing the production details, the director revealed that Rana Daggubati informed him that Karan Johar would produce the Hindi version. Meanwhile, the makers are actively searching for a major production house to anchor the Telugu version as the film remains in its early pre-production phase.

Mondeti also cleared up swirling rumors regarding Bollywood filmmaker Sanjay Leela Bhansali's association with the script. He explicitly stated that Mahakaal has no connection to Bhansali, confirming that the story and direction are entirely his own work, though he remains in talks with Bhansali for a separate future collaboration.

Reflecting on how the collaboration took shape, Mondeti shared that discussions began after meetings with Rana Daggubati in Mumbai, where a mythologically-rooted concept was finalized. The director noted that choosing a mythological narrative felt natural given the fascinating history surrounding the birthplace of Shiva.

In an exclusive update, the filmmaker clarified the project's current pre-production status and debunked rumors regarding Sanjay Leela Bhansali's involvement.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Spotlight Historical Details in New 'Ranabaali' Video
news.summary: Actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika have shared fresh historical insights regarding their upcoming film Ranabaali through a special promotional series. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the movie is scheduled to release on October 16.
body: The creative team behind the upcoming film Ranabaali has launched a four-episode documentary-style video series to give audiences a clearer understanding of the project's historical backdrop. Rather than focusing on the traditional freedom struggle, the first installment clarified that the narrative centers on a man-made famine during the Madras Presidency caused by British grain confiscations.

In the newly unveiled second episode, lead actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika discussed another lesser-known historical aspect. They pointed out that the British established the Indian railway system primarily to accelerate the transport of local grains, spices, cotton, and gold to ports rather than to improve domestic infrastructure.

Vijay noted that because historical accounts were written by British authorities, crucial facts were deliberately omitted from standard syllabi. Rashmika added that uncovering these deeper historical realities had a profound impact on her understanding of the era.
Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, Ranabaali is set to hit the big screen on October 16. The ongoing promotional series aims to contextualize the historical events that drive the film's plot.

body: The rural drama Maremma, which introduced Maadhav Bhupathiraju to cinema audiences, is officially making its transition to digital streaming. Maadhav, the nephew of Tollywood star Ravi Teja, made his debut when the film originally hit theatres on September 10, 2026.

news.title: Makers of Prabhas's 'Maremma'—'Fauji' In No Rush for New Release Date
news.summary: The high-profile collaboration between Prabhas and director Hanu Raghavapudi, titled Fauji, has faced further delay with its December 3 release postponed indefinitely. Producers are withholding a new date until remaining shooting schedules are finalized.
body: The much-anticipated period action film Fauji, starring Prabhas and directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, has encountered an indefinite postponement of its previously planned December 3 release window. Insiders indicate that the production team is in no rush to lock in a new theatrical date while filming remains incomplete.

A significant portion of the production is still pending, with sources noting that Prabhas requires more than 60 working days to wrap up his remaining sequences. Balancing these requirements alongside his active commitments to Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit means completing his portions could take roughly four more months.

Consequently, the production banner lacks definitive clarity on when principal photography will officially wrap. While trade speculation points toward a promotional poster or material arriving on Prabhas's birthday on October 23, insiders suggest the creators will likely sidestep announcing any concrete release timeline then.
The film features newcomer Imanvi taking on the female lead role, drawing considerable attention from fans eagerly awaiting updates on the large-scale production.

news.title: Karthi's Rapid OTT Transitions Ignite Debate Over Theatrical Windows
news.summary: Tamil star Karthi's spy thriller Sardar 2 is heading to Amazon Prime Video just 21 days after its theatrical run, marking his second quick digital release of the year. Trade analysts are expressing concern over how compressed streaming windows impact box office momentum.
body: The theatrical exclusivity window for Tamil cinema is facing renewed scrutiny following the rapid digital premiere of Karthi's latest spy thriller, Sardar 2. The film began streaming on Amazon Prime Video merely 21 days after its initial theatrical debut, following a quiet run at the box office.

This quick digital rollout mirrors an earlier pattern set earlier in the year by the actor's Pongal release, Vaa Vaathiyar. Despite premiering during the lucrative Sankranti festive window in five languages, that comedy-action film shifted to Amazon Prime Video just 14 days after opening in cinemas.

Traditionally, major star-led theatrical releases maintain an exclusive theatrical window lasting between four to eight weeks. This buffer allows producers, distributors, and theatre owners sufficient time to recover investments through ticket sales and strong opening-weekend footfalls.

Trade analysts warn that continuous quick streaming arrivals could alter audience behavior. If moviegoers anticipate that underperforming titles will land on home screens within two to three weeks, advance bookings and theatre attendance may suffer long-term consequences.
news.dek: Tamil star Karthi's spy thriller Sardar 2 is heading to Amazon Prime Video just 21 days after its theatrical run, marking his second quick digital release of the year. Trade analysts are expressing concern over how compressed streaming windows impact box office momentum.

news.title: End of an Era: Karan Johar Confirms Final Season for Koffee With Karan
news.summary: Celebrity chat show landmark Koffee With Karan is coming to a definitive close after a two-decade run. Host Karan Johar announced that the upcoming ninth season, streaming on JioHotstar from October 14, will be the final installment of the controversial and widely discussed series.
body: One of Indian television and streaming's most talked-about celebrity chat programmes is officially concluding its long-running journey. Host and filmmaker Karan Johar has announced that the upcoming ninth season of Koffee With Karan will be its last, bringing down the curtain on a format that began back in 2004.

In an emotional announcement, Johar reflected on the personal significance of the decision, recalling discussions about hosting the talk show with his late father, Yash Johar. Across 161 episodes and eight completed seasons, the show became a massive pop-culture fixture defined by candid celebrity revelations, rapid-fire segments, iconic coffee hampers, and occasional industry controversies.

Over the years, the series frequently drew public debate and social media scrutiny regarding industry dynamics and guest curation. However, it remained a high-profile platform for prominent film stars, with names like Rashmika Mandanna, Vijay Deverakonda, and Allu Arjun anticipated to make appearances in the upcoming final stretch.
The ninth season is set to premiere on JioHotstar starting October 14, leaving fans to watch whether the swan song will deliver an emotional farewell or additional headline-grabbing moments.

news.title: Ravi Teja Starrer Irumudi Claims Top Spot on Netflix Global Non-English Film Chart
news.summary: Ravi Teja's Irumudi has secured the number one position on Netflix's Global Top 10 list for non-English films. The Telugu drama accumulated 3.4 million views during its first full week on the streaming platform, adding to strong initial numbers following its September theatrical run.
body: Ravi Teja's recent cinematic outing, Irumudi, has found immense success on digital platforms, securing the number one position on Netflix's Global Top 10 list for non-English films for the week of September 21 to 27.

During this seven-day monitoring window, the Telugu feature registered 3.4 million views. This followed a strong debut after premiering on the platform on September 18, which also pulled in 3.4 million views in its initial three days, bringing its total to 6.8 million views since its OTT release according to reported figures.

Directed by Shiva Nirvana, the movie features Ravi Teja alongside Sai Kumar and Priya Bhavani Shankar. The narrative follows a troubled father embarking on a spiritual journey connected to his family and daughter. Netflix made the title available in Telugu audio alongside Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, and Kannada versions, capping off a successful transition from its theatrical run to global streaming prominence.

news.title: Allu Arjun's Raaka Eyed for a Two-Part Release Strategy
news.summary: Makers of Allu Arjun's highly anticipated film Raaka, directed by Atlee, are reportedly contemplating a two-part theatrical release. Given its massive budget, the first installment is speculated to arrive in December 2027, followed by a 2028 sequel.
body: Allu Arjun's upcoming global project Raaka, directed by filmmaker Atlee, has generated immense curiosity among movie lovers, notably after entering the Guinness Book of Records. While the high-profile venture was initially conceptualized as a single feature film, recent updates suggest a shift in release strategy.

Insiders reveal that due to the film's substantial budget, the makers have decided to divide the narrative into two parts. Under the current tentative timeline, the first part is expected to hit theaters in December 2027, with the subsequent installment slated for a 2028 release.

The ambitious production boasts a stellar star cast featuring Deepika Padukone as the female lead, alongside Mrunal Thakur, Rashmika Mandanna, Janhvi Kapoor, and Aishwarya Lakshmi in key roles. Allu Arjun is set to appear in multiple getups and across various timelines throughout the storyline.

Bankrolled prestigiously by the Sun Pictures banner, the film features music composed by Sai Abhyannkar. As anticipation continues to build around the project's production scale and format, official confirmation on the exact distribution timeline is eagerly awaited.
news.dek: Makers of Allu Arjun's highly anticipated film Raaka, directed by Atlee, are reportedly contemplating a two-part theatrical release. Given its massive budget, the first installment is speculated to arrive in December 2027, followed by a 2028 sequel.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Crosses Nizam Breakeven Milestone in Six Days
news.summary: Nani and Srikanth Odela's latest cinematic outing, The Paradise, has achieved a significant box office milestone by hitting breakeven in the Nizam region within six days. Despite mixed initial word of mouth, the movie has grossed approximately Rs. 170 crore globally.
body: Nani and director Srikanth Odela's collaborative project, The Paradise, has completed a six-day theatrical run marked by strong regional milestones. Despite carrying mixed talk from its early premiere shows, the movie successfully reached its breakeven mark in the Nizam region, inclusive of GST.

The film's theatrical share in Nizam currently hovers around Rs. 30 crore, bolstered by a steady contribution of roughly Rs. 83 lakh on Tuesday. Achieving profitability in this crucial territory within less than a week underscores the robust initial pull of the feature despite audience polarization.

On a global scale, The Paradise has accumulated a gross collection of approximately Rs. 170 crore so far. As the movie transitions into the critical weekday period, its sustainability at ticket windows will define the ultimate breadth of its theatrical lifespan.

To maintain momentum, lead actor Nani has been actively touring and promoting the film across Andhra Pradesh. Produced by SLV Cinemas, the rural drama features a prominent ensemble cast including Kayadu Lohar, Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, and Sonali Kulkarni, with a musical score by Anirudh Ravichander.

news.title: Anirudh Delivers Fanboy Tribute with 'One Name' Song from Jailer 2
news.summary: Composer Anirudh Ravichander has released 'One Name', a celebratory track dedicated to Superstar Rajinikanth for the upcoming sequel Jailer 2. Following a lukewarm response to earlier tracks, the new song aims to build vital pre-release hype.
body: The musical buildup for Superstar Rajinikanth's highly anticipated sequel, Jailer 2, has taken a new turn with the launch of the track 'One Name'. While the initial musical offerings from the film received a relatively quiet reception from listeners, this latest release has generated positive expectations among fans.

Composed by Anirudh Ravichander, the song functions as a direct tribute to the veteran actor. Although it may not replicate the explosive mass resonance of 'Hukum' from the first installment, the track successfully captures Anirudh's personal admiration and fandom for Rajinikanth.

The timing of the song's arrival is critical for the production team, who face a massive theatrical target and require intense pre-release momentum. With initial tracks failing to set benchmarks, 'One Name' provides the much-needed promotional energy heading into the final stretch.

Anirudh's musical synergy with Rajinikanth remains a major selling point for the franchise following the success of the original film. Attention now turns toward upcoming promotional assets, including Nora Fatehi's special appearance song and the official theatrical trailer.

news.title: Unusual Real-Life Cinema Passion Drives Anakapalli Promotion
news.summary: First-time producer Kandregula Naidu's unique journey into filmmaking—sparked by buying an entire theater after failing to get tickets for Prabhas's Mirchi—is generating distinct organic buzz for his rural drama Anakapalli.
body: The Telugu film industry often welcomes passionate outsiders, but producer Kandregula Naidu's entry into cinema via his debut project Anakapalli stands out due to a remarkable real-life backstory. Inspired by the film Bhageeratha, Naidu's passion for movies manifested literally when he faced ticket shortages.

Recalling an incident where he could not secure entry for a family screening of Prabhas's Mirchi at a local cinema in Anakapalli, Naidu decided to purchase the entire theater property instead. Today, he owns that exact venue, which will host the premiere release of his own production.

Directed by Khagesh Tammineni, Anakapalli stars Vikram Sahidev, Sandhya Vasishta, and Tarak Ponnappa in a raw, rustic rural setting. Prominent filmmaker Trinadha Rao Nakkina penned the story and screenplay while co-producing the movie alongside Naidu under Bhavya Sri Movie Makers and Nakkina Narratives.

The narrative follows a young man drawn into organized crime under a ruthless mob leader whose life shifts when he falls in love. Backed by Naidu's candid recounting of his journey from real estate success to film production, the project is capturing genuine curiosity ahead of its theatrical release.
news.dek: First-time producer Kandregula Naidu's unique journey into filmmaking—sparked by buying an entire theater after failing to get tickets for Prabhas's Mirchi—is generating distinct organic buzz for his rural drama Anakapalli.

news.title: Jr NTR Confirms Full Recovery From Shoulder Surgery, Ready to Resume 'Dragon' Shoot
news.summary: Actor Jr NTR has announced his complete recovery from a shoulder injury and subsequent surgery. He made the revelation while attending a pre-release event, confirming that he will soon return to the sets of Prashanth Neel's directorial venture, 'Dragon'.
body: Actor Jr NTR has officially announced that he has fully recovered from his shoulder injury and the subsequent surgery he underwent in Secunderabad. Speaking at a recent promotional event, the star confirmed his good health and stated that he is ready to get back to work.

With his recovery complete, the actor is set to resume filming for 'Dragon', directed by Prashanth Neel. Production on the movie had previously been paused to accommodate the actor's medical procedure and subsequent physiotherapy regimen.

Director Prashanth Neel is reportedly aiming to wrap up shooting for 'Dragon' by February, keeping the project on track for a theatrical release in June 2027. Jr NTR will focus entirely on completing this schedule before transitioning to his next commitments.

Looking further ahead, the actor's planned mythological collaboration with director Trivikram, which is reportedly centered on Lord Murugan, is expected to commence production following the conclusion of March.

body: The upcoming feature 'Don't Trouble The Trouble', starring Fahadh Faasil and produced by SS Karthikeya, received a significant surge in public interest following a recent promotional appearance by Jr NTR.
